item.description:
Added

  • Calendar: undo. After you move, resize or delete an event, a bar under the timeline says what changed, with an Undo button. Undo takes changes back one at a time, newest first, for as long as the Calendar tab is open. A deleted event comes back exactly as it was, guests and repeating events included.

Fixed

  • A mouse wheel no longer closes the notch. Scrolling with a mouse over the open notch used to close it. Only a trackpad swipe up does now.
